correctness.rationale: Modulo π, X gives A²=0 of rank r, counted by choosing image U, kernel K⊃U and isomorphism k^n/K→U; 2r<=n. Every A conjugates to J=[0 0 I_r;0 0 0;0 0 0]. GL_n(R)→GL_n(k) is onto, so all fibers over A biject to lifts X=J+πB, including mixed characteristic, since J²=0 over R. X²=0 iff JB+BJ=0 over k, which forces B_WU=B_WC=B_CU=0 and B_WW=-B_UU; other free blocks dimension 2r(n-r)+s². Remove r unit Smith pivots; residual πB_CC is arbitrary s×s, giving t=rank_k(B_CC). Multiply independent count factors and divide for conditional rank law. Independent full enumeration n=2 over Z/4 gives strata (0,0):1,(0,1):9,(0,2):6,(1,0):12, total 28; Z/9 gives 1,32,48,72 total153, matching formula. These finite tests do not establish all n/rings.
